# Poly Haven furniture models

Downloaded from Poly Haven on 2026-09-22. All listed assets are released under
the CC0 1.0 license: https://polyhaven.com/license

The project uses the 1K FBX editions with their supplied textures. Model files
are unmodified; scale, placement, colliders, and Unity URP materials are set by
`ManorSceneBuilder.cs`.
